items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: So I'm rehearsing with Jesse Stone every day.

ctx.x: To the USO. So I'm rehearsing with Jesse Stone every day. And there would be different units in the billing where we was rehearsing that. We was rehearsing at Noll Studios downtown on 52nd Street, I think...51st and Broadway. We rehearsed there. And there was a lot of bands rehearsing in there for different things. Well, that was takin' up my day. I mean, it was nice. I'd go down there. But after you get the show down letter-perfect, which the show only...it only run an hour... And after you get the show down…
Now, this was what kind of show? This had what kind of acts?
